{{Top|leg}}
A '''thrust converter''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component. [[Kal-tan-shi]]'s [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Accuser (720 light freighter)|''Accuser'']], had a faulty starboard thrust converter that helped to identify the vessel to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
